samples.question: Which coloured block covers an area closest to exactly one quarter of the panel's total coloured area? The framed panel is tiled by exactly four solid coloured blocks separated by thin pale gutters: one red, one blue, one green and one orange. The small colour swatches printed above the panel, the grey rings and the grey ticks are decoration and are never measured. Take the panel's total coloured area to be the sum of the areas of those four blocks. Answer with one colour: red, blue, green or orange.
